samples.question: A vertical timeline of five panels reads top to bottom. Each panel shows the same six slots (slot 1 to slot 6, left to right), and the two middle slots, slot 3 and slot 4, are shaded as a single band that appears in every panel. A single royal-blue token sits in exactly one slot of each panel, so the token is inside the shaded band when it occupies slot 3 or slot 4 and outside otherwise. Reading the panels in order, an entry occurs each time the token moves from an outside slot to an inside slot between two consecutive panels. How many entries does the blue token make into the shaded band over the whole timeline? Answer '0', '1', or '2'.
